metadata.title: A possible surviving companion of the SN Ia in the Galactic SNR G272.2-3.2

notes: No eligible stars. The proposed SN Ia surviving companion MV-G272 (Gaia EDR3 5323900211541075328; the abstract at T:p1-b9 prints the discrepant 5323900215411075328, while T:p8-b3 gives the repeated text/table identifier) is not presented as unbound from the Milky Way; a Galactic orbit with e = 0.447 is modeled for it (T:p10-b4; Figure 8 caption T:p12-b3). Star A (Gaia EDR3 5323871314998012928) is finally placed below the hypervelocity range (T:p25-b5), and no D6 hypervelocity star is found from this SNR (T:p27-b1); the D6 objects are prior references used for detectability (T:p26-b4).
